status: development interface audit; not a new theorem or natural replication
state_family: fixed public DAG plus zero or one candidate persistent addition
old_representation_promise: the stored label is the exact old restricted-cut encoding of the same frozen source state
producer_inputs: public base graph and candidate universe
authorized singleton membership API and query budget
constructor: Use public restricted cuts to compute K = active(new) minus active(old). An explicit stored delta requires no source query. A bottom label queries K in sorted order, skipping unauthorized candidates, stopping at the first positive or when all candidates are negative. Missing permission, stale source, or exhausted budget returns UNRESOLVED when ambiguity remains.
source_interface: Each unit-cost query tests whether the unique hidden addition equals one named candidate. The API enforces permissions, snapshot epoch and query budget. Initial source retention, raw-ID acquisition and public compilation costs are separate.
query_budgets: all integers from zero through candidate count
worlds: base plus each single candidate addition; every world for every fixture
verifier: After repair, independently enumerate legal failure sets and execute bitset transitive closure. Check successful native decoding and residual updates, and verify unresolved branches contain two compatible worlds with different native continuation behavior. Behavior enumeration is verifier-only.
required_checks: zero unauthorized, stale or over-budget producer queries
zero source queries for known explicit states or no newly active hidden candidates
all repaired states commute under legal budget-consuming deletions
base negative branch reads all K under a fully authorized sufficient budget
claim_boundary: The singleton-query lower bound is elementary and interface-specific. This audit executes R1/R3/R4 obligations; it does not close T2/T5, establish efficiency against mature graph algorithms, justify a new source oracle, or establish a natural phenomenon. No adaptive fixture changes after execution.
